name: Villainess Idolized By Everyone: White Incadescent Nights Treasure Eventide Recollections
source:
A cutesy collection of wintery short stories with Mirabelle and the guys doing wintery things.

~Bird of Paradise - take a walk through the snowy streets with Verderald~

~Sweetest Hearts - cook a fantastic dinner with Azure and Rodion~

~Cherished Days - reminisce on winters past with Cherne and Liebe~

~Dashing Rogues - run around the palace grounds with Sol and Fiore~




[From [url=https://jewelswithwings.itch.io/vibe-check-winter]itch.io[/url]]
